# PermitFlow

> > AI-powered construction permitting platform that automates permit applications, research, and approvals across nationwide jurisdictions using specialized AI agents.

PermitFlow provides a pre-construction platform with AI agents (Intake, Research, Submission, Coordination, and Issuance) to streamline construction permitting workflows. The platform offers SOC 2 compliance, nationwide coverage including Texas, Michigan, Kansas, and Idaho, and comprehensive resources for navigating municipal requirements.

## Key Topics

- PermitFlow
- AI Agents (Intake, Research, Submission, Coordination, Issuance)
